description: Public operations the web console performs. The console, the Python SDK and the rlworld CLI each implement every one; parity tests hold all three to this list.

operations.name: save_spec
operations.summary: Save a spec and get its immutable digest

operations.name: get_spec
operations.summary: Read a saved spec

operations.name: preflight
operations.summary: Validate, estimate and warn before any budget is spent

operations.name: dry_run
operations.summary: Play one episode end to end and watch it live

operations.name: launch
operations.summary: Launch every sweep point as a run

operations.name: get_experiment
operations.summary: Read an experiment's budget, spend and runs

operations.name: approve_experiment
operations.summary: Approve a launch above the approval threshold

operations.name: list_runs
operations.summary: List runs, optionally of one experiment

operations.name: get_run
operations.summary: Read a run's state and operational settings

operations.name: get_run_spec
operations.summary: Read the full spec a run plays, to clone or reproduce it

operations.name: control_run
operations.summary: Pause, resume, stop or change concurrency, priority or budget

operations.name: run_events
operations.summary: Stream a run's events

operations.name: list_episodes
operations.summary: List a run's episodes, running or finished

operations.name: get_episode
operations.summary: Read an episode with its steps and reward

operations.name: live_wall
operations.summary: Sampled running episodes with their latest frame

operations.name: get_frame
operations.summary: A frame, as a thumbnail or at full resolution

operations.name: frame_grant
operations.summary: A short lived grant to view frames, appended to frame URLs

operations.name: cohort
operations.summary: Finished episodes filtered for side by side scrubbing, with their filmstrips

operations.name: get_provenance
operations.summary: The checks, judge rationale, states and world diff behind a score

operations.name: get_step_prompt
operations.summary: The exact model input of one step

operations.name: review_episode
operations.summary: Flag, label, file a verifier bug, draft a task or add to an audit sample

operations.name: start_takeover
operations.summary: Take over a running episode: its env runs for you through noVNC while the policy waits

operations.name: end_takeover
operations.summary: Hand the episode back; your input is kept as its demonstration

operations.name: start_authoring
operations.summary: Start authoring from a saved spec: one generated task with its instruction and hidden intent

operations.name: get_authoring
operations.summary: An authoring session: its task, recordings and gate results

operations.name: begin_recording
operations.summary: Lease a dev env at the task's start state and drive it through noVNC to record an oracle, an alternative solution or a near miss

operations.name: end_recording
operations.summary: Stop recording: your input is kept as canonical actions with the state you left for the gates

operations.name: run_authoring_gates
operations.summary: Run every validation gate in fresh envs; the session reads running until the report is in

operations.name: submit_authoring
operations.summary: Submit the task with its gate report for human review

operations.name: analyze_failures
operations.summary: Label and cluster a run's failures and file bug tickets

operations.name: get_failures
operations.summary: Failure clusters per template and policy version

operations.name: run_report
operations.summary: Success rates with confidence intervals per template and difficulty, pass at k

operations.name: compare_runs
operations.summary: Runs side by side on the tasks they share

operations.name: clone_fidelity
operations.summary: Success on an app clone against success on the real app over the tasks both eval runs share

operations.name: compare_policy_versions
operations.summary: Policy versions side by side on the same tasks

operations.name: list_review_items
operations.summary: Review items by queue, status, run or episode

operations.name: list_catalog
operations.summary: List images, worlds, task templates, verifiers, rubrics or endpoints

operations.name: list_endpoints
operations.summary: List registered policy and judge endpoints

operations.name: register_endpoint
operations.summary: Register a BYO policy or judge endpoint

operations.name: test_endpoint
operations.summary: Probe reachability, latency, token ids and logprobs

operations.name: set_endpoint_key
operations.summary: Store an endpoint key in the vault; keys are write only

operations.name: auth_config
operations.summary: How to sign in: the OIDC issuer and client, or that sign in is off

operations.name: me
operations.summary: Who is signed in, with tenant and roles

operations.name: list_experiments
operations.summary: Experiments with budgets and spend, optionally for one tenant

operations.name: file_review_item
operations.summary: File a task failing its gates or an episode behind an alert for human review

operations.name: update_review_item
operations.summary: Resolve or dismiss a review item, with a label for labeling items

operations.name: calibration
operations.summary: Verifier precision and recall and judge kappa against human labels

operations.name: export_run
operations.summary: SFT rows or preference pairs, when the tenant's data policy allows the export

operations.name: list_roles
operations.summary: Roles granted by admins

operations.name: set_roles
operations.summary: Grant a user roles: viewer, researcher, operator, labeler or admin

operations.name: list_data_policies
operations.summary: Per tenant screenshot endpoints, retention windows and export rights

operations.name: set_data_policy
operations.summary: Set a tenant's data policy

operations.name: audit_log
operations.summary: Every launch, edit, stop, approval, role change and key write, newest first

operations.name: pool_status
operations.summary: Free license seats and identities per pool

operations.name: sweep_retention
operations.summary: Apply every tenant's retention windows now

operations.name: list_alerts
operations.summary: Alerts on runs: reward spikes, judge and verifier disagreement, error rate jumps, budget thresholds and completions

operations.name: acknowledge_alert
operations.summary: Acknowledge an alert

operations.name: fleet_admission
operations.summary: Fleet capacity, reservations, tenant quotas and endpoint budgets with what is in use

operations.name: set_tenant_quota
operations.summary: Set a tenant's concurrent env quota; zero means unlimited
